_rubric: Each item lists concept groups; a group is hit if ANY of its terms appears (case-insensitive). Score 2 = all groups hit, 1 = at least half, 0 = fewer.

items.prompt: A service handles 400 requests per second. Each request consumes 5 ms of CPU time on one core. The host has 4 cores. What is the average CPU utilization of the host? Show the calculation briefly.
Explain why CPU contention can increase p99 latency in a network-heavy Linux service. Be concise (under 200 words).

After a deployment, an API's p99 latency rose from 40 ms to 900 ms while p50 stayed at 12 ms. Host CPU utilization is only 35%, but the container's cgroup cpu.stat shows nr_throttled increasing rapidly. List the most likely causes, most likely first, and say what to check next.

Write a concise incident diagnosis with exactly these headings: Symptom, Hypotheses, Evidence needed, Next action. Facts: on node-3, TCP retransmissions rose 20x, p99 latency rose 6x, and the NIC rx_dropped counter is increasing.
